title: Plumeform pricing plans (v2)
description: Two plan cards side by side on paper. The free plan is a near-white 28px card: name and a big price on one line, a short line, a list with teal ticks and a solid pill at its foot. The paid plan glows deep teal with paper text: a paper monthly/yearly pill toggle beside the price, a line, a paper pill CTA, a small note, paper ticks and a footnote. Above them an eyebrow and heavy heading (a page title or a section title with a link at the right). Cards rise and un-blur into view.
notes: the featured card is dark by itself (dark class) and uses the theme's glow colour
needs JavaScript for the monthly/yearly toggle (hydrate: visible); without it monthly shows
